source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt:
A wide cinematic interior of a moody research laboratory at night, rendered in polished 3D digital art with soft volumetric lighting and a teal-and-amber color palette.

LEFT SIDE: A large floating holographic display panel with a glowing cyan border, angled slightly toward the viewer. At the top in bold white sans-serif text: "EvidenceGrade AI". Below it, smaller white text: "5-tier grade". A vertical stack of five colored grade bars, each with a bold white letter on the left: green bar "A", teal bar "B", yellow bar "C", orange bar "D", red bar "F". To the right of the bars, a line graph titled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026" with a y-axis numbered 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 and a jagged cyan line rising from bottom-left to upper-right, with the x-axis label "Citation Confidence 2019-2026" repeated beneath it.

CENTER: A glowing translucent DNA double helix floating upright above a stainless steel lab table, built from cyan glassy spheres connected by thin cyan rods, with scattered gold/amber spheres as accent nodes. Behind it, a white wall with two floating shelves holding amber glass reagent bottles with white labels reading "Aspirin", "Warfarin", "Ibuprofen" (labels partially legible), plus a brass microscope on the left shelf and a potted monstera plant with large split green leaves on the right shelf.

FOREGROUND: On the brushed steel tabletop, an open spiral-bound notebook with handwritten notes, the visible heading reading "CYP3A4 interaction risk" with illegible scribbled lines below; a black-and-gold fountain pen resting diagonally across the page; a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid on a matching saucer, the cup showing a visible crack; a small brass hook-shaped object near the notebook.

RIGHT SIDE: A large arched window with dark frame, rain streaking the glass, looking out onto a neon-drenched Asian city street at night with vertical glowing signs in red, pink, and cyan featuring Chinese characters, wet reflective pavement. On the windowsill, a black cat silhouette sitting upright, a closed dark red umbrella leaning against the frame, and a small red lantern glow.

CEILING: Three brass articulated pendant lamps with dome shades — two emitting warm amber light, one emitting green light — plus a brass multi-arm fixture.

ATMOSPHERE: Rainy night, cool teal ambient light mixed with warm lamp pools, glossy reflections on metal and glass, shallow depth of field, high detail, sci-fi laboratory aesthetic, 3D render style.
